info.title: ChoiceOpenTransactionPusher
info.description:
# Introduction 
 The Choice Open Transaction Pusher is a set of HTTP Web APIs that provide Vendor wise Order Book and real time order status on callback API. The APIs deals with JSON request and response structures. This document will provide step by step guide to use the API right from Authentication to the request response of structure of the API, error codes and messages.
 # Getting Started 

 First of all the client needs to request for callback url registration, once url registered they will recive real time order status on callback API.
 # Important Points 
 1. VendorId and VendorKey mandatory to pass in request header in keys **VendorId: TEST**, **VendorKey: XXXXXXX** in every request. VendorId and VendorKey will be given in person.
 2. All Passwords related fields need to be encrypted with **AES CBC 256 PKCS7 Encoding** Algorithm in request. Encoding Key and IV will be given in person.

post.summary: API to Get Order Book Listing
post.description:
Description

    This API returns Order Book Listing based on vendor id
    
    Once API return Data not found then stop calling this API 

Parameters

    VendorId : TEST
    StartPos : Starting position for fetching records (Numeric)
    NoOfRecords : Number of records to be fetched (Numeric)
     
Parameter Types

    1."string" stands for String Type
    2.0 (Zero) stands for Numeric.
            
OrderType 
            
    RL_LIMIT : Regular limit order
    RL_MKT : Regular market order
    SL_LIMIT : Stop loss limit order
    SL_MKT : Stop loss market order

BS 

    1 for Buy 2 for Sell

Validity 

    1 for Day, 4 for IOC
            
ProductType 

    M for Margin/Intraday 
    D for Delivery 
    AM for AMO Margin for Equity segments and AMO Intraday for Derivative Segments
    AD for AMO Delivery for Equity Segments and AMO CARRYFORWARD for Derivative Segments

Order Status
    
    CLIENT XMITTED : Order sent from client, confirmation awaited
    GATEWAY XMITTED : Order sent from Gateway, confirmation awaited
    OMS XMITTED : Order sent from OMS, confirmation awaited
    EXCHANGE XMITTED : Order sent from Exchange, confirmation awaited
    PENDING : Order confirmed from exchange
    CANCELLED : Order cancelled
    EXECUTED : Order Traded
    GATEWAY REJECT : Order rejected by gateway
    OMS REJECT : Order rejected by oms
    ORDER ERROR : Order rejected from exchange
    FROZEN : Order rejected from exchange (The order will go for a freeze if the quantity is greater than the freeze quantity determined by NSE)
    A.ACCEPT [ADMINACCEPT]
    A.REJECT [ADMINREJECT]
    A.MODIFY [ADMINMODIFY]
    A.CANCEL [ADMINCANCEL]
    AMO SUBMITTED : AMO order submitted successfully
    AMO CANCELLED : AMO order cancelled successfully

Segment Master ID's

    NSE-CASH: 1
    
    NSE-DERIVATIVES: 2
    
    BSE-CASH: 3
    
    BSE-DERIVATIVES: 4
    
    MCX-DERIVATIVES (COMMODITIES): 5
    
    MCX-SPOT (COMMODITIES): 6
    
    NCDEX-DERIVATIVES (COMMODITIES): 7
    
    NCDEX-SPOT (COMMODITIES): 8
    
    NSECDS-DERIVATIVES (CURRENCIES): 13
    
    NSECDS-SPOT (CURRENCIES): 14

401.description: Unauthorized. VendorId or VendorKey is invalid or doesn't exist.
